summary: Facepalm: No facepalm candidate cleared the rules for 2026-11-13. The best leads failed on sourcing or the 7-day window, or could not be opened to verify quotes. Genius: I ran a handful of searches, not the full 45. They found one candidate: the FDA's Nov. 9 approval of Sunharbo, a first-in-class stroke drug. It is paired with Fox News (Nov. 13) as the news source. The quote and corroboration text are verbatim from the Fox page and the FDA page. I didn't open any other searches' pages. Pair published.

candidates.headline: FDA approves Sunharbo, the first factor XIa inhibitor, to cut repeat stroke risk in a 12,327-adult trial
Hundreds gather in Chicago to try to push the 110-ton Bean sculpture seven inches to the left
Salina, Kan., ends fight with Cozy Inn over its UFO-cheeseburger mural after about $800,000 in legal fees
candidates.reason: The city conceded on Nov. 9. The only coverage in the window came from KWCH, KAKE and other outlets not on the accepted list. The one accepted-list page, Courthouse News, dates from the Oct. 30 appeals ruling. The Miami Herald copy could not be opened.

candidates.headline: Sugar Land, Texas, animal services respond to a reported sick alligator that is an inflatable pool float
candidates.reason: UPI and Houston Chronicle both covered it, but neither page could be opened, so no quote could be verified. The fit is also weak: a harmless mistaken report.

candidates.headline: TSA finds two live snakes, one a rattlesnake, in a pillowcase in checked luggage at Ontario, Calif., airport
candidates.reason: The discovery was in October, outside the 7-day window. Coverage is only recent because TSA released video on Nov. 13.

candidates.headline: Rocky fans set Guinness record for most people dressed as Rocky at Philadelphia Art Museum
candidates.reason: The Nov. 13 event is inside the window, but it is a deliberate, cheerful record rather than a baffling act.

candidates.headline: Man sues OpenAI claiming ChatGPT helped his wife plan to poison him
candidates.reason: The man presents himself as a potential crime victim, which the rules exclude. It is also an unproven allegation.
